name: Create kanban
description: In migrating functionality from the Kanban component to KanbanContainer, the focus was on fixing the "Add Kanban" button functionality. I provided an updated version of `KanbanContainer.vue`, enhancing the logic by implementing methods like `showNewBoardModal` to initiate new board creation and `onDeleteBoard` for board deletion. Additionally, placeholders for methods like `toggleBookmark`, `createSubTask`, and `moveChatsToColumn` were set up for future logic extensions. This update aims to address issues with adding new Kanban boards while ensuring the KanbanContainer fully replicates the original component's functionality.
